scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @agent-board/shared build && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @agent-board/shared watch" "pnpm --filter @agent-board/backend dev" "pnpm --filter @agent-board/frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @agent-board/shared build && pnpm --filter @agent-board/backend build && pnpm --filter @agent-board/frontend build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @agent-board/shared build && pnpm --filter @agent-board/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @agent-board/backend typecheck && pnpm --filter @agent-board/frontend lint && pnpm --filter @agent-board/frontend typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @agent-board/shared build && pnpm --filter @agent-board/shared test && pnpm --filter @agent-board/backend test
